brand.label: NC Sound
brand.tagline: Albums, audio apps, sound kits and media from the NC Sound / Overlay 365 studio.

apps.name: NC Sound Lab
apps.blurb: Procedural beatmaker and sound-design workstation. Chaos-synth DSP, 13-module studio rack, EBU R128 compare engine, AAF export straight into Pro Tools.

apps.name: Field Studio
apps.blurb: The phone half of NC Sound Lab. Pre-roll capture so you catch the take before you hit record, onset slicing, YIN tuning, seeded evolution, .ncbeat export.

apps.name: NC Phone Beat
apps.blurb: 16-pad MPC-style sampler with a C++17 real-time engine. Per-step ratchet, probability and swing; four synths onboard; projects export as .ncbeat into NC Studio.

apps.name: NC Studio
apps.blurb: 16-track mobile DAW with clip timeline, per-track DSP and an AI mix assistant. Imports .ncbeat sessions from Phone Beat and Field.

apps.name: Concordance
apps.blurb: Evidence adjudication client: anchors, claims, a deterministic Referee audit and a research agent, all synced to the hub. The audit is reproducible by content hash.

apps.name: Overlay Radio
apps.blurb: A continuous online station for the catalogue — shows, unreleased beats and guest mixes. Built and waiting on a host.

apps.name: Math X
apps.blurb: Computer-algebra workbench with a proof verifier, export panel and step-by-step derivation. 28 components, built for research notes that need to be checkable.

apps.name: AetherDesk
apps.blurb: Inbound leads, partner outreach, support triage and campaign attribution in one desk. Consumes signed research signals; emits subscription and partner events.

apps.name: Sieve
apps.blurb: One dashboard for what every surface is doing: health, recall over the memory spine, and a 24-hour ecosystem summary. Refuses PHI at the edge.
notes: Signed in with the hub account

apps.name: Recourse
apps.blurb: Durable research memory and an idea forge, plus Kaggle job monitoring so long-running compute is visible from the phone.
notes: Jobs polled through the mobile gateway

apps.name: OpenHub
apps.blurb: Code from the phone: opencode with a set of MCP servers wired in, sessions shared with the desktop, and the ecosystem registry in one place.

kits.name: Drum Kits
kits.detail: Kick, snare, hat and perc sets rendered from the chaos-synth engine. Round-robin ready, 24-bit WAV.

kits.name: 808 & Sub
kits.detail: Tuned sub packs with glide, drive and x-sub layers, keyed for trap, drill and slow R&B.

kits.name: Leads & Stabs
kits.detail: Hard-sync and wavefolded leads with the ladder filter printed in, plus dry versions for your own chain.

kits.name: Pads & Textures
kits.detail: Granular scatter beds, tape-saturated drones and evolving atmospheres for intros and breakdowns.

kits.name: Chaos FX
kits.detail: Risers, impacts and circuit-bent one-shots from the bitcrush and granular stages.

kits.name: Field Recordings
kits.detail: Room tone, machines, rain and street takes captured on the Field Studio and cleaned with its denoise chain.
